description: United by a strong work ethic and a passion for technical innovation, our team of four balances seamless coordination with effective time management as we continuously expand our capabilities. Our core competencies include the design and analysis of aircraft and launch vehicle mechanisms. We bring hands-on technical proficiency in SolidWorks, ANSYS and BenchTwin simulation software. Combining creativity with a rigorous work ethic, we are eager to collaborate and develop impactful solutions.
